content:
July 24 Update: The LinkedIn post has been deleted. Below is the original report content.

Sofia Coelho, the art director who led the visual design and conceptual creation for the MacBook Neo advertising campaign, shared behind-the-scenes insights into the birth of the "Little Finder" mascot. Details below.

"Just one apple tall"

Apple art director Sofia Coelho shared an interesting photo collection on LinkedIn today, showing several behind-the-scenes photos from the creation of "Little Finder" for the MacBook Neo advertising campaign.

In her post, Coelho thanked colleagues involved in this Cannes Lions-shortlisted project in the form of a half-joking birthday announcement, describing the opportunity to lead the visual design and concept of this character as "a dream design project".

She also shared a photo showing hand-drawn sketches and reference images of "Little Finder" with various expressions, proportions, and overall styling, as well as what appears to be a physical prototype painted with an airbrush.

"Little Finder" made frequent appearances throughout the MacBook Neo advertising campaign. Apple also had the character star in a live-streamed show and a series of TikTok short videos. It quickly became a meme online, inspiring fan-created works including fan art, wallpapers, and printable 3D models.

The character also made a cameo appearance in at least one WWDC 2026 session in the form of an Easter egg, and appeared as a badge in attendees' gift bags.
